findings.message: PROCESS: the rev-14 node pair returned TWO majors — a scheme-less credential-shaped argv[0] was rendered in full by displayProgram (the URL branch only triggered on `://`), and Docker's own listing order could decide the target because containerCandidates was not running-first while `ambiguous` only trips for more than one RUNNING container — plus the claim-vs-code gaps (host-runner's sameSpot never actually delegated, containerOnlyMounts kept its own prefix math, the withheld path double-rendered, a dead keepText binding, a wrong redaction comment, and both READMEs missing the reverse guard). All fixed in this revision. Re-sealing.
